declarations.docstring: A predicate relating an endomorphism, a finite basis, and an indexed scalar family through triangularization data.
The matrix of an endomorphism in such a basis is block triangular with respect to the index order.
Expresses the characteristic polynomial as the product formed from the indexed scalars.
Identifies each diagonal matrix entry with its corresponding indexed scalar.
Two pointwise ordered finite index maps are equal when their associated index data agree.
A splitting characteristic polynomial and the stated dimension yield a basis and scalar family satisfying the triangularity predicate.
The displayed map on an exterior-power subspace commutes with the induced endomorphism.
A block triangular matrix gives the triangularity predicate for its associated linear map, standard basis, and diagonal entries.
Reindexes a product over a finite ordered set by its order embedding from a finite type.
A product of selected matrix entries vanishes for distinct index maps satisfying the stated condition.
Computes the coordinates of the specified vector in the constructed basis as a single supported function.
A diagonal entry of the induced exterior-power matrix equals the determinant of the corresponding minor.
Computes the trace of the indicated exterior-power endomorphism as a sum of products of indexed scalars.
Derives the exterior-power trace formula from a factorization of the characteristic polynomial.
Computes the degree-one exterior-power trace as the sum of the indexed scalars.
Computes the top exterior-power trace as the product of the indexed scalars.
Computes the trace of the indicated symmetric-power endomorphism by a sum over multisets.
Derives the symmetric-power trace formula from the displayed characteristic-polynomial factorization.
Computes the degree-one symmetric-power trace as the sum of the indexed scalars.
